sentences.text: Its ten numbered recommendations address charging decisions, counselling records, disclosure, police dealings with defence lawyers, retrial decisions and complaints between agencies.

findings.quote:
Regrettably, I have found it necessary to make several serious findings of misconduct on 
the part of Mr Shane Drumgold SC, the Director of Public Prosecutions.

None of these mistakes 
actually affected the substance of the investigation and none of them prejudiced the case.

I recommend that the government, in consultation with stakeholders, enact 
legislation to codify the scope and content of the obligation of disclosure owed by 
the Prosecution in criminal proceedings.

notes: The Introduction provides the report’s overview of scope and principal findings. There are ten numbered recommendations; a separate recommendation in the Introduction concerns continued public access to the inquiry website. Appendices include proposed adverse findings and party submissions, which are not treated as final findings. The principal misconduct finding is quoted verbatim and therefore retains the name printed in the report.
